powers.description: At the end of this creature's turn, it gains [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
powers.dynamic_description: 这个生物在自身回合结束时，会获得[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]力量[/gold]。

powers.description: At the end of [blue]3[/blue] turns, deal [blue]40[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
powers.dynamic_description: 在第[blue]3[/blue]回合结束时，对所有敌人造成[blue]40[/blue]点伤害。

powers.description: If you take unblocked attack damage this combat, die.
powers.dynamic_description: 如果你在这场战斗中受到未被格挡的攻击伤害，则立即死亡。

powers.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] additional card reward at the end of combat.
powers.dynamic_description: 在战斗结束时额外获得[blue]1[/blue]份卡牌奖励。

powers.description: Whenever you play a card, gain {singleStarIcon}.
powers.dynamic_description: 你每打出一张牌，获得{singleStarIcon}。

powers.description: Steals [gold]Gold[/gold] when Attacking.
powers.dynamic_description: 攻击时偷走[gold]金币[/gold]。

powers.description: When hit by an attack, deal damage back.
powers.dynamic_description: 当被攻击命中时，反击造成伤害。

powers.description: Whenever you [gold]Evoke Lightning[/gold], deal [blue]8[/blue] damage to each enemy hit.
powers.dynamic_description: 每当你[gold]激发闪电充能球[/gold]时，对命中的敌人造成[blue]8[/blue]点伤害。

powers.description: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and discard [blue]1[/blue] card.
powers.dynamic_description: 在你的回合开始时，抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌并丢弃[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

powers.description: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of the next [blue]2[/blue] turns.
powers.dynamic_description: 在下[blue]2[/blue]个回合开始时获得[blue]5[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。

powers.description: [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies take [blue]2[/blue] times more damage from Attacks.
powers.dynamic_description: [gold]虚弱[/gold]的敌人从攻击牌中受到[blue]2[/blue]倍伤害。

powers.description: Whenever you create a Status, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random Orb.
powers.dynamic_description: 每当你生成状态牌的时候，随机[gold]生成[/gold][blue]1[/blue]个充能球。

powers.description: At the start of your turn, draw a card and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
powers.dynamic_description: 在你的回合开始时，抽一张牌然后[gold]消耗[/gold]你的一张[gold]手牌[/gold]。

powers.description: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each turn, double the amount gained.
powers.dynamic_description: 每个回合你第一次从卡牌中获得[gold]格挡[/gold]时，将数值翻倍。

powers.description: The next [gold]Ethereal card[/gold] you play costs [blue]0[/blue].
powers.dynamic_description: 你打出的下一张[gold]虚无[/gold]牌耗能为[blue]0[/blue]。

powers.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
powers.dynamic_description: 每当你给予[gold]易伤[/gold], 抽[blue]1[/blue]张牌。

powers.description: Your next Attack deals additional damage.
powers.dynamic_description: 你的下一张攻击牌伤害增加。
powers.notes: Declared methods: InitInternalData, BeforeAttack, ModifyDamageAdditive, AfterAttack

powers.description: ALL [gold]Skills[/gold] are [gold]Tainted[/gold] [blue]2[/blue].
powers.dynamic_description: 所有[gold]技能[/gold]牌都拥有[gold]污染[/gold][blue]2[/blue]。
powers.notes: Declared methods: BeforeCombatStart, AfterCardEnteredCombat, AfterCardPlayed, AfterRemoved, AfterPowerAmountChanged

powers.description: The first [blue]2[/blue] cards you play each turn are free to play.
powers.dynamic_description: 每回合你打出的前[blue]2[/blue]张牌会免费打出。
powers.notes: Declared methods: AfterApplied, AfterRemoved, InitInternalData, BeforePowerAmountChanged, BeforeApplied, TryModifyEnergyCostInCombatLate, TryModifyStarCost, AfterCardPlayed, BeforeSideTurnStart, ShouldSkip, HideTemporaryZeroCostVisual

powers.description: Vulnerable creatures take [blue]50%[/blue] more damage from Attacks.
powers.dynamic_description: 易伤的生物从攻击中受到的伤害增加[blue]50%[/blue]。

powers.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] per turn.
powers.dynamic_description: 每回合获得的[gold]能量[/gold]减少[blue]1[/blue]点。

powers.description: Weakened creatures deal [blue]25%[/blue] less damage with Attacks.
powers.dynamic_description: 虚弱的生物造成的攻击伤害减少[blue]25%[/blue]。

powers.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] up to [blue]1[/blue] card.
powers.dynamic_description: 在你的回合结束时，[gold]保留[/gold]最多[blue]1[/blue]张手牌。

powers.description: Every [blue]6[/blue] cards you play, add a [gold]Wither[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
powers.dynamic_description: 你每打出[blue]6[/blue]张牌，将一张[gold]凋萎[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

powers.description: At the start of your turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
powers.dynamic_description: 在你的回合开始时，失去[blue]1[/blue]点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。
